title: Hash router with per-screen query allowlists

claims.text: parseRoute maps empty, bare and agents hashes to the agents screen, accepts single-part agents/lineage/arena/ledger paths plus agents/{agentId} and arena/{benchId} two-part paths, and falls back to agents with an unknown-page notice for anything else.

parseRoute refuses control characters, encoded separators, duplicate keys and forbidden keys, keeps only allowlisted query keys per screen from the registry, and flags the rest as ignored with a notice.

formatRoute emits the canonical hash with sorted, encoded query entries and throws on forbidden or unsafe keys; createRouter supports both callback-first and hash-first call shapes, canonicalizes via replaceState, navigates via pushState, and disposes the hashchange listener.

decision.rule: Change here when route parsing, per-screen query allowlists, canonical hashing, or router lifecycle needs to change.
decision.failure: A valid screen falls back to Agents, an unknown query field is silently kept, or navigation does not canonicalize the hash.

questions.q: Where does parseRoute enforce the per-screen query allowlist?
Where should I change the fallback route for unknown pages?
Where can I debug why a query field is reported as ignored?
